actionVerite.ambd_classique: The questions and dares that suit every couple
actionVerite.ambd_marrant: To laugh and tease each other
actionVerite.classique_q1: What was the first thing you liked about me?
actionVerite.classique_q2: Which moment of our story would you relive right now?
actionVerite.classique_q3: What do I do that reassures you without my realising it?
actionVerite.classique_q4: What is the one thing you have never dared to ask me?
actionVerite.classique_q5: When did you realise this was serious between us?
actionVerite.classique_q6: What do you miss most when I am not around?
actionVerite.classique_q7: Which compliment would you like to hear more often?
actionVerite.classique_q8: What are you proudest of in me?
actionVerite.classique_q9: Which of my habits would you never change?
actionVerite.classique_q10: What makes you feel loved, very concretely?
actionVerite.classique_q11: What is your best memory of us this year?
actionVerite.classique_q12: If you could keep only one photo of us, which one?
actionVerite.classique_q13: What would you like us to do more often?
actionVerite.classique_q14: Is there something you have never told anyone but me?
actionVerite.classique_q15: Honestly, where do you see us in five years?
actionVerite.classique_d1: Say three things you love about me, looking me in the eye.
actionVerite.classique_d2: Send me the message you would have written at the very start of our story.
actionVerite.classique_d3: Give me a thirty second hug, without speaking.
actionVerite.classique_d4: Tell the story of our first meeting as if you were telling a stranger.
actionVerite.classique_d5: Write me a note on paper and hand it over without reading it out loud.
actionVerite.classique_d6: Look me in the eye for a full minute, without saying anything.
actionVerite.classique_d7: Tell me one thing I did for you that you have never forgotten.
actionVerite.classique_d8: Pick the song that makes you think of us and play it now.
actionVerite.classique_d9: Give me a compliment that has nothing to do with how I look.
actionVerite.classique_d10: Take my hand and tell me what you want for us this year.
actionVerite.classique_d11: Imitate the way I say « I love you ».
actionVerite.classique_d12: Thank me for three different things.
actionVerite.classique_g1: Message your best friend right now, just to say you were thinking of them.
actionVerite.classique_g2: Sing the chorus of the first song that comes into your head.
actionVerite.classique_g3: Let the other person pick your wallpaper for the next 24 hours.
actionVerite.classique_g4: Massage the other person's shoulders for two minutes.
actionVerite.classique_g5: Make the next drink for both of you.
actionVerite.classique_g6: Tell your worst first date story, from any point in your life.
actionVerite.classique_g7: The other person asks a question and you answer with no filter.
actionVerite.classique_g8: Promise to give a real compliment to the first person you message tomorrow.
actionVerite.marrant_q1: What is the silliest thing you have ever seen me do?
actionVerite.marrant_q2: If we swapped lives for a day, what would scare you most?
actionVerite.marrant_q3: What ridiculous nickname would you give me if you absolutely had to pick one?
actionVerite.marrant_q4: What is your worst habit, the one you will not own up to?
actionVerite.marrant_q5: What do I do that annoys you but makes you laugh anyway?
actionVerite.marrant_q6: If our relationship were a TV series, what would it be called?
actionVerite.marrant_q7: What is the most harmless lie you have ever told me?
actionVerite.marrant_q8: What is the most embarrassing thing in your search history?
actionVerite.marrant_q9: Which of us would be voted off first on a survival show?
actionVerite.marrant_q10: What is your most perfectly useless talent?
actionVerite.marrant_q11: If you had to sell me on a classified ads site, what would you write?
actionVerite.marrant_q12: What is the stupidest argument we have ever had?
actionVerite.marrant_q13: What is the most expensive thing you bought and never used?
actionVerite.marrant_q14: If you were filmed secretly for a whole day, which bit would you cut?
actionVerite.marrant_q15: What do you always do when nobody is watching?
actionVerite.marrant_d1: Imitate the other person waking up in the morning.
actionVerite.marrant_d2: Mime a film for the other person to guess, in thirty seconds.
actionVerite.marrant_d3: Speak with an accent of your choice until your next card.
actionVerite.marrant_d4: Show the last photo in your gallery, without choosing it.
actionVerite.marrant_d5: Dance for ten seconds to the music the other person picks.
actionVerite.marrant_d6: Read your last sent message out loud, with a lot of emotion.
actionVerite.marrant_d7: Imitate an animal until the other person guesses which one.
actionVerite.marrant_d8: Take the worst possible selfie and keep it for a week.
actionVerite.marrant_d9: Tell an embarrassing story about yourself, in under a minute.
actionVerite.marrant_d10: Try saying « I love you » in three different languages.
actionVerite.marrant_d11: Sum up your day in three emojis and have the other person guess.
actionVerite.marrant_d12: Act out the most annoying advert you know.
actionVerite.marrant_g1: Post a story with the filter the other person chooses.
actionVerite.marrant_g2: Taste a spoonful of something you do not like.
actionVerite.marrant_g3: Let the other person write your next message to someone else.
actionVerite.marrant_g4: Ten press-ups, or ten squats, the other person decides.
actionVerite.marrant_g5: Hold an ice cube in your hand for twenty seconds.
actionVerite.marrant_g6: Call someone close and slip in the sentence the other person gives you.
actionVerite.marrant_g7: Hop around the room on one foot.
actionVerite.marrant_g8: Let the other person do your hair however they like for five minutes.
